study: Nested training-only application retention for frozen PFAD scores
inputs: all frozen query candidates; no CT-derived visibility or ROI filtering
selection: Each method independently chooses one global per-record retention using the other 13 specimens. Exactly ceil(f*n) or at least 3 points per record, capped at n; ties resolved by original index. All methods use the same bounded correction.
registration_target: complete requested-anatomy CT mesh, available only to downstream registration/evaluation after selection is frozen
level_units: rotation magnitude degrees around a random unit axis
translation magnitude mm in a random unit direction
primary_aggregation: exclude aligned-start diagnostic; average starts and levels within each case, anatomies within each specimen, then report 14 paired specimen values
solver: Open3D multiscale point-to-plane ICP with Huber loss, fixed for all methods
success_criterion: translation error <4 mm AND rotation error <5 degrees; computational benchmark threshold, not clinical acceptability
reference_basis: known imposed transform composed with the released CT-US alignment; no independent surgical fiducials were found
reference_prior_art: https://github.com/luohwu/NeuralBoneReg-implementation (uses UltraBones100k and synthetic rigid perturbation; our local-initialization protocol is distinct and results will not be compared across protocols)
statistics: 14 paired specimen means; 100000 specimen bootstrap resamples; two-sided Wilcoxon; Holm over 4 baselines x 2 original endpoints. Exploratory development p values, not external confirmation.
stage: retrospective nested development; all 14 specimens previously inspected in reconstruction and application diagnostics
rationale: The reconstruction policy retains 90 percent to optimize candidate F1. This experiment selects retention for the downstream alignment objective without changing the trained scoring model or robust registration backend.
ranking: PFAD anatomy probability times surface probability, fixed before results; geometry negative cross-sweep nearest distance; random seeded uniform rank
policy_objective: minimum mean virtual target RMS displacement, starts within anatomy within specimen; ties prefer larger retention
outer_score_model: reuse frozen 12-epoch seed-17 13-specimen outer models via saved head probabilities; no held-out fitting
inner_score_model: three specimen-disjoint folds on the 13 outer-training specimens only; attentive_set soft teacher, epochs12 batch8192 learning_rate0.001 seed17; all three head losses unchanged
inner_starts: draw0 from each of the three original perturbation levels; 3 starts per anatomy; controls can be cached because they do not use a trained score
outer_starts: all original 15 perturbations and aligned diagnostic; policies saved before any selected-policy outer registration
model_selection_boundary: assert outer specimen absent from inner training, validation, and policy aggregation; validate input and output hashes on resume
